interpretations.decision: Keep one logical session and one policy authority, but use a separate two-party media room per client incarnation alongside media-disabled shared coordination. The pinned SFU has no durable receiver track allowlist and client-owned publisher permissions are cooperative. Room isolation preserves the intended privacy boundary; it is a transport adaptation rather than the paper's literal single-room topology.

The formal occupancy rule excludes higher-class content from every channel in occupied or unknown rooms, while headset scenarios suggest an exception. Pending an explicit policy decision, new routing must fail closed; a private headset is not an implicit exemption.

A private output does not authorize sensitive memory retrieval for a shared-origin request. Require a new authorized private-origin continuation rather than importing private memory to satisfy the shared-microphone example.

Exact runtime outcomes can gate controlled expressions and action templates. Arbitrary model prose is not proven universally outcome-truthful, in either native audio or generated-text TTS; invariant 10 remains unverified.
